'''Pinurquians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of horned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] active in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. One well known member was [[Tinketh Fo]], the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keyorin]].

The [[Alderaanian Resistance]] encountered the animated corpse of a Pinurquian in [[Darth Rivan]]'s secret archive room on [[Almas]]. The Pinurquian had been killed in a firefight between the [[Stalfonauts]] and [[Jacen Yar]]'s team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
